platformFaq.q: De onde vem a telemetria do Sigmaward?
platformFaq.a: Do Agente Sigmaward, instalado nos endpoints. MISP, provedores de IA e canais de notificação têm funções específicas; não são fontes genéricas de ingestão de logs.

platformFaq.q: Qual é o papel da inteligência artificial?
platformFaq.a: Apoiar a investigação e a engenharia de detecção com contexto do tenant. A interface oferece consultas Lucene, explicação e criação de regras Sigma e criação de casos. As propostas precisam ser revisadas antes da execução.

platformFaq.q: O monitoramento substitui a investigação de segurança?
platformFaq.a: As duas visões se complementam. CPU, memória, disco e rede mostram a saúde operacional; alertas, casos e evidências sustentam a investigação de segurança.
Não. Relatórios e trilhas de auditoria ajudam a organizar evidências para programas de conformidade; não equivalem à certificação do produto.

site.companyIntro: Sigmaward é a plataforma comercial de segurança da Bocchi Company. Um produto em desenvolvimento que reúne detecção, investigação, resposta e monitoramento de endpoints.
site.companyStoryTitle: O contexto faz parte da solução.
companyStory: Um alerta é apenas o início. Para decidir o próximo passo, a equipe precisa entender o ativo, os eventos relacionados, a investigação em curso e as ações disponíveis.
O Sigmaward aproxima essas etapas com agente próprio, regras Sigma, gestão de casos e monitoramento de infraestrutura. A proposta é manter o contexto acessível a quem precisa investigar e responder.

Connect cloud, identity, endpoints and SaaS in minutes.

site.architectureBody: The agent sends telemetry to the platform. Events live in a tenant-specific index; cases, observables and audit records retain operational context.

architecture.title: Endpoint collection
architecture.body: A native agent for Windows, Linux and macOS. Events, inventory and metrics with durable delivery and authenticated identity.

architecture.title: Detection and context
architecture.body: ECS events in OpenSearch, Sigma rules and correlation. Cases and observables are stored in Postgres, separated by tenant.

architecture.title: Decision and response
architecture.body: Analysts investigate signals, organize response in playbooks and track actions and approvals in the audit trail.

site.agentTitle: One agent for security and asset health.
site.agentIntro: The Sigmaward Agent collects the telemetry behind SOC and NOC operations. Available collectors vary by operating system; fleet monitoring tracks availability and agent resource use.

agentPlatforms.body: Windows Event Log, Sysmon/PowerShell when available, processes, file integrity and inventory.
journald, process execution through tracefs, file integrity, inventory and host metrics.
Unified Log, processes, file integrity and native CPU, memory, disk and network metrics.

site.agentNote: Collection depends on configuration, permissions and the capabilities available on each operating system.

governanceLayers.title: Data per tenant
governanceLayers.body: Postgres RLS and a dedicated event index per tenant separate operational data.

governanceLayers.title: Identity and access
governanceLayers.body: Keycloak, SSO and role-based permissions organize access. Temporary support access remains traceable.

governanceLayers.title: Evidence and continuity
governanceLayers.body: HMAC-chained audit records, reports and encrypted tenant backups support governance.

platformFaq.q: Where does Sigmaward telemetry come from?
platformFaq.a: From the Sigmaward Agent installed on endpoints. MISP, AI providers and notification channels have specific roles; they are not generic log ingestion sources.

platformFaq.q: What is the role of artificial intelligence?
platformFaq.a: Support investigation and detection engineering with tenant context. The interface offers Lucene queries, Sigma rule explanation and creation, and case creation. Proposals need review before execution.
The two views complement each other. CPU, memory, disk and network describe operational health; alerts, cases and evidence support security investigation.
No. Reports and audit trails help organize evidence for compliance programs; they do not certify the product.

site.companyIntro: Sigmaward is Bocchi Company's commercial security platform. A product in development bringing together detection, investigation, response and endpoint monitoring.
site.companyStoryTitle: Context is part of the solution.
companyStory: An alert is only the beginning. To decide what comes next, the team needs to understand the asset, related events, the ongoing investigation and available actions.

Sigmaward brings these stages together with its own agent, Sigma rules, case management and infrastructure monitoring. Its purpose is to keep context accessible to the people investigating and responding.
